Resolves #19131

Seven browser-component witnesses pin Clock's hand angles, inline size/font styles and disc toggle. The size transition exposed a runtime bug: deleting dimensions restored the wrapper's original `500px`. Clock now clears them with explicit nulls, following the existing `component.Base` style contract and the [ticket author's approved exception](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/19131#issuecomment-6678879517).

Evidence: L3 (actual App-worker configuration and rendered inline DOM in the component tier) → L3 required. Full current-head component CI remains a pre-merge gate.

| AC-2 | CI-covered: seven cases, one per table row. All time changes start from explicit `08:10`, so midnight cannot pass on the default state. Size clearing first observes `300px`; the disc control observes present → absent → present. |
